n, m, P = map(int, input().split())
f = [0] * (m + 1)
g = [0] * (m + 1)
C = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]

f[0] = 1
for i in range(m + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P

def upd(x, y):
    x += y
    if x >= P:
        x -= P
    return x

for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        f[j - 1] = upd(f[j - 1], 0)
        f[i - j] = upd(f[i - j], 0)
        val = (f[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % P
        val = (val * (i + 1)) % P
        val = (val * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P
        f[i] = upd(f[i], val)

        val_g = (f[j - 1] * g[i - j] + f[i - j] * g[j - 1]) % P
        val_g = (val_g * (i + 1)) % P
        val_g = (val_g * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P
        g[i] = upd(g[i], val_g)

        val_g2 = (C[j][2] + C[i - j + 1][2]) % P
        val_g2 = (val_g2 * f[j - 1]) % P
        val_g2 = (val_g2 * f[i - j]) % P
        val_g2 = (val_g2 * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P
        g[i] = upd(g[i], val_g2)

p = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
q = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
p[0][0] = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(min(i, m + 1)):
        for k in range(j + 1):
            if j - k >= 0:
                p[i][j] = upd(p[i][j], (p[i - k - 1][j - k] * f[k]) % P * C[j][k])
                q[i][j] = upd(q[i][j], ((p[i - k - 1][j - k] * g[k]) + (q[i - k - 1][j - k] * f[k])) % P * C[j][k])
    if i <= m:
        p[i][i] = f[i]
        g[i] = g[i]

print(q[n][m])
